summary: Learn ESG risk management for boards and executives with ISO 31000, COSO ERM, scenario analysis, and board-ready reporting tools.
lede: ESG risk management for boards and executives provides a structured way to identify material environmental, social, and governance exposures, assess controls, set priorities, and connect decisions with enterprise risk appetite. Using frameworks such as ISO 31000, COSO ERM, ISSB IFRS S1, and IFRS S2, the course helps leaders make ESG oversight more traceable and decision-focused. You will practise double materiality mapping, scenario analysis, ESG risk scoring, governance and escalation mapping, dashboard design, and executive reporting pack development. The training also introduces assurance considerations, GRI and SASB cross-mapping, and AI-assisted ESG signal monitoring to help you build practical board-ready reporting despite data gaps, budget pressure, and changing disclosure expectations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and specialists who must translate ESG risk information into governance decisions, disclosure outputs, and practical action across the enterprise. It fits professionals who already understand business risk or reporting and now need a structured way to manage ESG exposure at board and executive level.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software and the ability to work with structured risk and reporting templates. Familiarity with board reporting, enterprise risk registers, sustainability disclosures, or assurance processes will help you move faster through the exercises. No programming, advanced analytics setup, or specialist ESG software license is required for completion.
